resources.string: MPV: interpolation and target-FPS changes reopen this video at the same timestamp, restoring play/pause state and selected tracks. A brief interruption is expected.
MPV configuration controls interpolation. This shortcut only saves the app preference; change the overriding mpv.conf options to change the effective setting.
Native: changes apply to this playback only when its existing interpolation renderer is ready. Otherwise they are saved for the next playback; the video is not restarted.
Changing target FPS does not turn interpolation on. Enable frame interpolation to synthesize additional frames.
Interpolation is off. The target FPS is saved; enable interpolation to synthesize additional frames.
Applying interpolation settings. Reopening at the same position…
MPV settings applied. Playback position, play/pause state and selected tracks restored.
Could not confirm the interpolation restart. Your setting is saved; reopen the video to apply it.
Interpolation setting saved. This video is not ready or cannot seek back safely, so it was not restarted.
